en.headline: Elderly Day offers free public transport and venue discounts for seniors across Hong Kong
en.dek: The annual event on Sunday gives people aged 65 and above free rides on MTR, buses and other services, with additional offers at attractions and shops.
body: Seniors aged 65 and above can travel free on major public transport today for Elderly Day 2026, with the MTR, KMB, Citybus and other operators waiving fares when the appropriate card is used.

The Hong Kong Council of Social Service and participating operators said the theme this year is “Joyful Living Together, Citywide Departure”. Eligible seniors tap JoyYou Card or senior Octopus on MTR, light rail and MTR buses for zero fare, with similar arrangements on most franchised buses and trams.
Some ferry routes, including Star Ferry, allow a free companion. Selected green minibus routes and other ferries also offer free or reduced rides for those aged 60 and above.

Attractions such as Ocean Park offer free or discounted entry for seniors, and Peak Tram provides free rides. More than 230 shops and organisations have additional discounts on dining and retail for the day.
Details of individual offers vary by operator and venue. Seniors are advised to check requirements such as card type before travelling.

zh.headline: 長者日今日舉行 65歲或以上可免費乘搭港鐵巴士等公共交通
zh.dek: 年度活動周日展開，多間營辦商提供免費車資，景點及商戶亦有優惠。
body: 長者日2026今日舉行，65歲或以上人士持樂悠咀或長者八達通，可免費乘搭港鐵、九巴、城巴等主要公共交通工具。
社聯及參與營辦商表示，今年主題為「樂活同行·全城出發」。合資格長者在港鐵、輕鐵及港鐵巴士拍卡即車資為零，大部分專營巴士及電車亦有類似安排。
部分渡輪航線包括天星小輪可帶一名同行者免費，指定綠色小巴及其他渡輪則對60歲或以上提供免費或優惠。
海洋公園等景點提供免費或折扣入場，山頂纜車亦有免費優惠。超過230間商戶及機構當日推出餐飲及購物折扣。
各項優惠細節因營辦商及場地而異，長者出發前宜確認所需證件或拍卡方式。
